lines.zh: 我把翅膀收在身侧，一步不落。
lines.en: Wings folded at my sides, I miss no step.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩得很轻，怕踩塌雪。
lines.en: My claws step light, afraid to break the snow.
I keep my wings tucked at my sides.
You speed up. So do I.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的腿走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle your legs once.

lines.zh: 这身绿鳞，在草里不显眼。
lines.en: These green scales blend with the grass.
I sniff along, watching ahead.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴抬起来，不拖地。
lines.en: I lift my tail off the ground.

lines.zh: 你停下，我也停下，爪子收好。
lines.en: You stop, and I stop, claws tucked in.

lines.zh: 我走在你的右边，习惯了。
lines.en: I walk on your right. Habit.
Step by step. Quiet.
I know this ground. Let me lead.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着点遗迹的灰。
lines.en: There's still ruin dust on me.

lines.zh: 我走在你侧后方，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I walk at your rear flank, wings folded.

lines.zh: 我坐在你脚边，翅膀松着。
lines.en: I sit by your feet, wings loose.
I hold still and listen.
I look up at you, waiting for orders.

lines.zh: 我靠在你脚边，鳞片温着。
lines.en: I lean at your feet, scales warm.
My scales show green in the light.
I don't eat much. Easy to keep.
I'm waiting for the ring's command.

lines.zh: 这一带没有敌人，我放松些。
lines.en: No enemies here. I ease up.

lines.zh: 我眼皮沉了一下，又撑开。
lines.en: My lids droop, then open again.

lines.zh: 我把身体盘起来，靠着石头。
lines.en: I coil against a stone.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的翅膀动了一下。
lines.en: The wind stirs my wings.
I listen to your breathing. Steady.
Old scars on me.
I wait for you to say go.
You take the ring. I know.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，喉咙里轻轻响。
lines.en: I raise my head. A soft sound in my throat.
If you ride, I'll lower myself.

lines.zh: 我凑过去，蹭了蹭你的手。
lines.en: I lean in and nudge your hand.

lines.zh: 你的手放在我背上，我不动。
lines.en: Your hand on my back. I hold still.
I know you. Always have.
Point, and I go.
I won't bite you. Never.
I raise my head, waiting for you to mount.

lines.zh: 你叫我的名字，我耳朵就动。
lines.en: Say my name and my ears move.
You step back. I still follow.
I spread my wings for you to see.
If you're tired, I'll slow down.
Let's take a trip.

lines.zh: 龙薇兽的眼，一直跟着你。
lines.en: A drakvyrn's eye follows you always.
Look back and I'm here.
A scale is gone. I retreat.
I growl and fall back behind you.
That caught my wing.

lines.zh: 疼得厉害，我往你身后缩。
lines.en: It hurts; I shrink behind you.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收起来，护住身体。
lines.en: I fold my wings to guard myself.
I can still stand. Don't worry.
A scale fell; I slowed half a beat.
I press closer to you.

lines.zh: 鳞片翘起一片，我忍着没叫。
lines.en: A scale lifts; I hold back the cry.
I look up at you. Still here.
I don't eat it. Thank you.
You hold it up; I lean in to sniff.
Not hungry; you eat it.

lines.zh: 我只要跟着你，别的不要。
lines.en: I only want to follow. Nothing else.

lines.zh: 这味道像遗迹里的旧灰。
lines.en: This smells like the old dust in the ruins.
One sniff, and I look up.
If you eat it, I'll watch.
That's not for me to eat.
I turn my head away. Not interested.
Keep it. It would jar my teeth.
A tamed dragon gives half a step.
I'm hard. Not soft to hit.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收拢，腾出半步。
lines.en: I fold my wings to give you half a step.
That flattened the grass.
I slip behind you and follow.
One wingbeat and the grove darkens.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收起来，腾出路。
lines.en: I fold my wings to make room.

lines.zh: 我站稳了，你先看自己有没有事。
lines.en: I'm steady; check yourself first.
All right? I'm hard.
I stand beside you and hold.
With you here, I look for nothing else.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搭在你肩头，很轻。
lines.en: I rest my chin on your shoulder, gently.
We sit side by side, watching the distance.
Only us in this part.

lines.zh: 我不说话，只用翅膀碰了碰你。
lines.en: I don't speak. I touch you with a wing.

lines.zh: 你把指环收起来，我也不走。
lines.en: Put the ring away. I still won't leave.
At dark I keep watch over you.
A quiet night.
You're asleep. I'm still listening.

lines.zh: 天亮以后，我们还在一起。
lines.en: After dawn, we're still together.

lines.zh: 这点东西我用爪子拨到你跟前。
lines.en: I flick this over to you with a claw.
Not edible. I leave it.
I nudge it toward you.
I carry it, waiting for you to take it.

lines.zh: 这么小，我的爪子都嫌轻。
lines.en: So small my claw barely feels it.
You could use this.

lines.zh: 这东西我塞进你的行囊侧袋。
lines.en: I tuck it into your pack's side pocket.

lines.zh: 闻过就知道，这个你用得上。
lines.en: One sniff tells me you'll want this.
I watch the ground for you.

lines.zh: 我把它带到你面前，才松口。
lines.en: I carry it to you before letting go.
Something's near. I raise my head.
I've stepped in front of you.
I guard this ground.
My wings spread to block.
Step back a little. I'll handle it.

lines.zh: 绿鳞贴着我，飞起来像一片叶。
lines.en: Green scales make me fly like a leaf.
I lower my head, claws dug in.

lines.zh: 我横过身，把你挡在后面。
lines.en: I swing across, putting you behind me.
It shouldn't have come this close.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，护住你。
lines.en: I turn sideways to shield you.
My eyes stay nailed to it.
Say stop, and I stop.
I'll move first. Don't step in.

lines.zh: 这一片草，被我们压出一条线。
lines.en: We've pressed a line in the grass.
Where you point, I fly.
It goes left. I turn left.
Step by step, I close in.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀半张，隔开你们两个。
lines.en: Wings half-open, I keep the two of you apart.
I hold my pace, waiting for it to move first.
My tail keeps swinging.
Hold my scales. Don't let go.
I know this ground. I can flank it.
It gives a foot, I take a foot.
One block closer and I can bite.

lines.zh: 你在我背上，我看得见前面。
lines.en: With you on my back, I can see ahead.
I haven't roared. Very quiet.

lines.zh: 气味顺着风，我先闻到了它。
lines.en: The wind carries a scent; I smell it first.
Put on the ring and I will fly you.

lines.zh: 指环一亮，我就知道该扑了。
lines.en: The ring glints, and I know it's time to lunge.
Claws land first, the body follows.
I bite down. Solid.
That knocked it back.
My tail whips and catches it.
I come down on it from above.
Afterward I return to your side.

lines.zh: 这一下，不是为你，是为我。
lines.en: That was for me, not for you.

lines.zh: 绿色鳞片，飞起来带着火。
lines.en: Green scales, and fire in flight.

lines.zh: 翅膀扫过去，把它拍了一下。
lines.en: My wing sweeps and swats it.
Green scales spread, and I carry you up.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口热气，爪还抬着。
lines.en: I huff out hot breath, claw still raised.
Light. Enough to move it.

lines.zh: 我回头看了看你，没事吧？
lines.en: I glance back at you. All right?
I'm steady. I can still fight.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，就认得你。
lines.en: I came out of the egg knowing you.

lines.zh: 我先看了看自己的爪子。
lines.en: First I look at my own claws.

lines.zh: 这里的空气，没有遗迹的灰。
lines.en: No ruin dust in this air.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀抖开，还没长满。
lines.en: I shake out my wings. Not fully grown.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走了一圈，认下了。
lines.en: I circle you once and accept you.

lines.zh: 我在等指环的第一道命令。
lines.en: I wait for the ring's first command.

lines.zh: 这地方很亮，我有点不习惯。
lines.en: Bright here. I'm not used to it.
I raise my head and sniff you.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着蛋壳的味。
lines.en: I still smell of eggshell.
I've taken my place beside you.
I want to try flying.
I spread my wings slowly. Wide.

lines.zh: 这一片，比我出生那间大。
lines.en: Bigger than the room I was born in.

lines.zh: 指环在你手上，我就跟你走。
lines.en: The ring is on your hand; I go where you go.
I raise my head, waiting for you to mount.
Let's go.
My first sound. Very soft.
I've lowered myself.
Fire curls my scales.
I fall. My wings didn't catch.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我的翅膀就重了。
lines.en: Soaked, my wings grow heavy.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀出去，我护住了头。
lines.en: The blast flings me; I cover my head.

lines.zh: 一截箭杆斜插在肩甲边。
lines.en: A broken shaft sticks out by my shoulder scale.
That light presses me to the ground.
Hungry too long. I can't fly high.

lines.zh: 雷落在背上，我腿一软跪了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my legs buckle.
Green wings suddenly won't fold.
